`lzma2.7z` and `aes7z.7z` come from the test data of github.com/bodgit/sevenzip
(BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2020 Matt Dainty). Stored RAR 4 archives are
generated by the tests.

`lzma.zip`, `lzma-slip.zip` (ZIP method 14, D097) and `rar5-wrap.rar` (RAR 5
stream crossing the decoder window, D098) are synthetic and deterministic:
regenerate them with `go run ./internal/infrastructure/archive/testdata/gen`.
